comment: EventBridge rules — these are managed by SAM templates, not edited here. This file is documentation only.

rules.name: audit-completed-fanout
rules.description: Fires when an audit completes. Fan-out to Sheets, Slack, WebSocket, Logger.

rules.name: deal-stage-changed
rules.description: Fires when a deal stage changes. Audit trail + downstream notifications.

rules.name: meeting-scheduled
rules.description: Fires when Calendly confirms a meeting. Writes to Meetings table.

rules.name: meeting-transcribed
rules.description: Fires when Fireflies finishes a transcript. Writes to Meetings table.
